title: OutlookSearchHit
description: One locally matched email for an outlook.search_emails.v1 query.

snippet.description: Short plain-text excerpt around the strongest match. Never a full message body.

matchedIn.description: Fields the query matched. Known values include subject, body, sender, attachmentName, and attachmentContent. Receivers ignore unknown values.

matchedAttachmentNames.description: File names of attachments whose name or extracted text matched the query.
